raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
#8813 registered CPU Lion for the CPU accelerator. `TestLionConfigs` (`tests/unit/ops/lion/test_lion.py`) gated both of its cases on `CPULionBuilder` only, so on the CPU accelerator the non-offload case now runs and builds `FusedLion`, which has no CPU implementation:
```
ValueError: This op had not been implemented on CPU backend.
```

#8813's CI did not catch it because `test_lion.py` was skipped at module level unless the accelerator supports fp16. On the CPU accelerator that needs native fp16 support (AVX512-FP16), which few GitHub-hosted runners have (4 of 37 recent `cpu-torch-latest` runs). All six CPU runs of #8813 landed on runners without it.

## Changes
- Gate each config on the op it builds: the `FusedLion` case on `FusedLionBuilder` and the `DeepSpeedCPULion` case on `CPULionBuilder`, instead of one `CPULionBuilder` check for both. 
- Run the test in fp32 and remove the module-level fp16 skip. The test only checks which optimizer `deepspeed.initialize` builds, and that depends on optimizer offload, not precision (`_configure_basic_optimizer` in `engine.py`). The test now runs on every runner instead of only on fp16-capable CPUs. The Lion ops are still tested in fp16 by `TestCPULion` in `test_cpu_lion.py`.

files.patch:
@@ -4,22 +4,24 @@
 # DeepSpeed Team
 
 import deepspeed
-import torch
 import pytest
 
 from deepspeed.ops.lion import FusedLion
 from deepspeed.ops.lion import DeepSpeedCPULion
 from unit.common import DistributedTest
 from unit.simple_model import SimpleModel
-from deepspeed.accelerator import get_accelerator
-from deepspeed.ops.op_builder import CPULionBuilder
+from deepspeed.ops.op_builder import CPULionBuilder, FusedLionBuilder
+
+# Each config builds a different optimizer, so each one is gated on the op it needs.
+requires_fused_lion = pytest.mark.skipif(not deepspeed.ops.__compatible_ops__[FusedLionBuilder.NAME],
+                                         reason="FusedLionBuilder has not been implemented on this system.")
+requires_cpu_lion = pytest.mark.skipif(not deepspeed.ops.__compatible_ops__[CPULionBuilder.NAME],
+                                       reason="CPULionBuilder has not been implemented on this system.")
 
-if torch.half not in get_accelerator().supported_dtypes():
-    pytest.skip(f"fp16 not supported, valid dtype: {get_accelerator().supported_dtypes()}", allow_module_level=True)
 # yapf: disable
 #'optimizer, zero_offload, resulting_optimizer
-lion_configs = [["Lion",  False, FusedLion],
-                ["Lion",  True,  DeepSpeedCPULion]]
+lion_configs = [pytest.param("Lion", False, FusedLion,        marks=requires_fused_lion),
+                pytest.param("Lion", True,  DeepSpeedCPULion, marks=requires_cpu_lion)]
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
     'optimizer, zero_offload, resulting_optimizer',
@@ -28,11 +30,11 @@ class TestLionConfigs(DistributedTest):
     world_size = 1
     reuse_dist_env = True
 
-    @pytest.mark.skipif(not deepspeed.ops.__compatible_ops__[CPULionBuilder.NAME], reason="CPULionBuilder has not been implemented on this system.")
     def test(self,
              optimizer,
              zero_offload,
              resulting_optimizer):
+        # Precision does not affect which optimizer is built; fp32 keeps the test independent of fp16/bf16 support.
         config_dict = {
             "train_batch_size": 2,
             "steps_per_print": 1,
@@ -43,9 +45,6 @@ def test(self,

             },
             "gradient_clipping": 1.0,
-            "fp16": {
-                "enabled": True
-            },
